title: Control Copilot Cowork rollout
subtitle: Pick billing, set limits and alerts, then scope access for a pilot.

steps.title: Choose the billing method
steps.evidence: choose Capacity Packs or pay-as-you-go before activation.

steps.title: Set limits and alerts
steps.evidence: Configure monthly and per-user limits, alerts, and a security-group scope so the pilot has measurable boundaries.

steps.title: Restrict access to pilot users
steps.evidence: Customize the policy and scope it to a specific security group, then add a small group of trusted users before expanding access.
